seoTitle: Private Hire — Exclusive Boat Hire for Events & Celebrations — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Hire a whole boat for your event with Manchester River Cruises. Exclusive private hire for corporate events, celebrations, weddings, filming and parties from Salford Quays. Enquire today.
heroIntro: Exclusive hire of the whole vessel for your event — corporate days, celebrations, weddings and more.
aboutBody: Private hire gives you exclusive use of one of our vessels — a striking, memorable setting on the water for whatever you're planning. Our team will help tailor every detail, from catering to timings, so you can simply enjoy the occasion.
aboutTbcNote: Full private hire details — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).
included: Exclusive use of the whole vessel
christmasHeading: Your office Christmas party, on the water
christmasBody: Take the whole boat for your office or group Christmas do — decorated bow to stern for the season, with a licensed bar, a dancefloor and the floodlit waterfront gliding past. It’s the standout way to celebrate a team, and it beats the same old function room.
christmasEmphasis: December dates go fast — book early.
christmasTbcNote: Catering, drinks packages and festive extras — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).
schoolsBody: School trips, colleges, scouts and youth groups sail as a private charter — the whole boat for a daytime educational visit, with commentary tailored to your age range. (Not party or prom bookings.)
enquireSuccess: Thanks for your enquiry. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
